newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Madagascar gets Chinese sports centre for Games.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar gets Chinese sports centre for Games.

text.p: President Didier Ratsiraka of Madagascar was given the keys on Wednesday to a modern sports centre, built by China, to help stage the Francophone Games next August.

Built next to the main stadium in Antananarivo, the 7,000-seat centre was a Chinese government aid project costing about $15 million. The Games are between countries where French is solely or partly spoken.
China's deputy prime minister Jiang Chunyun, who handed over the building, had earlier signed a grant of 30 million yuan ($3.6 million) to be used in part to buy 5,000 tonnes of rice.
Political sources linked China's generosity with the presence on the Indian Ocean island of a "special delegate" from Taiwan who is promoting economic ties.

A majority of Madagascar's members of parliament back Taiwan's request to establish full diplomatic relations but China, which says Taiwan is a rogue province, has warned it will immediately sever its own relations if that happens.
